objective_resolver: Harmonic analysis check against the published local pressure decomposition (Wolf, J. Math. Fluid Mech. 2015; Seregin Lecture Notes 2014): p_loc=Delta^-1 div div(chi~ u tensor u) is CZ-bounded in L^3/2(Q_n) by ||u||^2_L3(2Q_n); p_har=p-p_loc is harmonic in Q_n by construction. success iff the commutator is genuinely absorbed in the cited CZ-bounded p_loc and p_har is exactly harmonic (mean-cancellation exact, no remainder); 0.5 if one extra standard integrability hypothesis on the cutoff is needed; fail iff a non-CZ non-harmonic O(1) remainder genuinely survives in the harmonic-tail pressure-work term.
question: R1 of the Birkhoff near-2D route: in the suitable-weak local-energy pressure-work term INT p (u.grad phi), does the pressure localization commutator [chi, Delta^-1] land entirely in the Calderon-Zygmund-controlled local part p_loc (cited Wolf 2015 / Seregin local pressure decomposition), so that p_har := p - p_loc is EXACTLY harmonic in Q_n and the incompressibility (div u=0) mean-cancellation INT (mean p_har)(u.grad phi)=0 is exact with NO uncontrolled O(1) commutator remainder in the harmonic-tail term? Success => R1 discharged, harmonic-tail pressure-work = oscillation-only <= C Lambda^-1 M ||u.grad phi||_1.
success_threshold: success iff commutator absorbed in cited CZ p_loc AND p_har exactly harmonic AND mean-cancellation exact; 0.5 if extra cutoff integrability hypothesis; fail iff surviving non-CZ O(1) remainder
void_conditions: Birkhoff near-2D route abandoned upstream / R1 restated
